---
title: "How to read this book?"
---

Practical checklists and maintenance notes for setting up a home,
gardening on a balcony or small plot, and keeping a road bike in good
working order.

The book is organised in three parts:

1. **Gardening and planting** — containers, substrate, crops, herb
   care on an east-facing balcony, and basic tools.
2. **Interior DIY and equipment** — room-by-room shopping and setup
   lists for moving in.
3. **Bicycle maintenance** — anatomy, brakes, gears, wheels and tyres,
   and steering adjustment.

All lists use GitHub-style task checkboxes (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) so you
can tick items off as you go.
